context_for_next_testing_agent: Deal Health System fully tested. Backend: GET /api/deals/{deal_id}/health returns health status (VERDE/AMARILLO/ROJO/INACTIVO), color, summary, alerts array, counts. Alert structure: id, severity (ALTA/MEDIA/BAJA), category, problem, cause, action, actions. Semaphore logic: >=2 ALTA = ROJO, 1 ALTA = AMARILLO, >=2 MEDIA = AMARILLO, any alert = AMARILLO, 0 alerts = VERDE. NC-01 (sin traccion) triggers for deals published >7 days with 0 NDAs. NDA-sin-interest check added for NDAs >10 days without engagement. Frontend: Health indicator badge in DealManagement header shows SANO (green) or AMARILLO/ROJO with count. SALUD DEL DEAL section in overview tab shows alert cards with category badge, severity, problem, cause, action, CTA buttons. Alert cards have colored left border (red for ALTA, amber for MEDIA, slate for BAJA). Readiness widget and Q&A tab badge still working (regression verified).
